environment.profile: local acceptance on Darwin arm64; synthetic fixtures only

BIO-ATT-003-AC01.finding: Tenant-scoped named shifts expose configurable start, end and grace periods with compare-and-swap versioning.

BIO-ATT-003-AC02.finding: Clock events derive explicit complete, open, unmatched and overlapping pair states without guessing irregular durations.

BIO-ATT-003-AC03.finding: Overtime, lateness and absence are derived from immutable events and shift policy. Same-day early arrivals and overnight boundary cases are classified without the prior 24-hour wrap error.

BIO-ATT-003-AC04.finding: Exceptions are separate append-only adjustments requiring a validated audit reason; computed overtime remains visible and unchanged.

BIO-ATT-003-AC05.finding: The approved /attendance surface uses the AttendanceService workforce port. Real-host and LIVE browser evidence prove an authenticated administrator loads and creates a shift, persistence is confirmed by a follow-up read, and a signed unprivileged viewer receives 403 with visible failure and no false success.

final_acceptance.reason: AC01-AC05 map to exact-commit implementation, executable tests, real-host and real-browser workflow evidence, and the required independent QA PASS. Fresh feature, traceability, module-direction and secret checks pass; the one focused frontend failure is the pre-existing unrelated IntegrationService fixture gap.
